_comment: Verified anchors for the spoofers-discount artifact. The trajectory strip and per-step reproduction errors are an illustrative-but-faithful model of Proof-of-Learning's top-Q verification; the headline cost/threshold figures below are taken from the primary sources and surfaced verbatim in the UI.

pol.paper: Jia et al., Proof-of-Learning: Definitions and Practice (IEEE S&P 2021)
pol.auditRule: re-execute the top-Q largest weight-update intervals per epoch; accept if reproduction error d ≤ δ

zhang.paper: Zhang et al., 'Adversarial Examples' for Proof-of-Learning (IEEE S&P 2022)

fang.paper: Fang et al., Proof-of-Learning is Currently More Broken Than You Think (2022)
fang.secondAttack: Blindfold Top-Q — plant valid large updates where the verifier looks, hide forged ones among unaudited steps
fang.verdict: PoL cannot currently achieve provable robustness

gauntlet.paper: Lidin et al., Incentivizing Permissionless Distributed Learning of LLMs (2025)
gauntlet.note: statistical loss-delta scoring + OpenSkill, not a cryptographic proof of training
